description: Definitions shared by every model schema.

kebab-id.description: A lowercase identifier made of letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

http-url.description: An absolute web address a person may follow: scheme http or https, nothing else. One definition for every URL and ELI field, so that a script, data, file, ftp or mail URI never enters the model.

label.description: A short name; English is required, Dutch where available.

text.description: A longer text; English is required, Dutch where available.

source-ref.description: The id of a source file under model/sources/.

jurisdiction-id.description: A jurisdiction id: two uppercase ASCII letters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 style codes, plus EU and XI) or GLOBAL for worldwide schemes (SPEC section 4).

jurisdiction-ref.description: The id of a jurisdiction file under model/jurisdictions/.

certainty-ref.description: A member of the certainty vocabulary.

vocab-member.description: Base of a vocabulary member; a cited source and a certainty come together. The closing unevaluatedProperties lives in the schema that uses this base.

scheme-ref.description: The id of a scheme file under model/schemes/.

authority-ref.description: The id of an authority class or instance under model/authorities/ (DEC-031).

icd-code.description: An ISO 6523 ICD code or a Peppol EAS code: exactly four ASCII digits, always quoted so leading zeros survive (DEC-036); null or absent means no code is recorded.

header-authority.description: A scheme issuer: an authority class, or an instance for a national-only scheme. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

header-jurisdiction.description: A scheme jurisdiction. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

header-kind.description: The kind of a scheme. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

header-text.description: A short free-text header value, for example an abbreviation. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

header-kebab.description: A kebab-case header value, for example availability. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

header-code.description: An ISO 6523 ICD or Peppol EAS code, or null. A bare value is covered by the scheme default source with certainty certain; the long form { value, source, certainty } overrides that for this field only (DEC-029).

condition.description: When a statement applies (SPEC 5.3): a closed set of keys, at least one. issuing_country may be negated with a leading ! (for example "!NL"); entity_form and context come from their vocabularies.

statement.description: Base of every scheme statement: its own source and certainty (DEC-029), an optional condition, and an optional free-text note covered by that source (D-09). The closing unevaluatedProperties lives in the schema that uses this base.

capture.description: Run a regular expression on a value and take one capture group (group 0 is the whole match). Used by transforms and by context_from.
